extra: Matching edited readonly refusal versus explicit literal initialization, zero writes/focus/selection/FormData.

cases.original: a root Fragment from the server is interactive under caller-owned direct adoption
cases.current: a root Fragment from the server is interactive under caller-owned direct adoption
cases.mapping: Root Fragment keeps original nodes and live handlers; successful SSR marker remains unchanged.

cases.original: what the user entered before activation survives adoption, and later updates still apply
cases.current: edited public controls and mismatched legacy defaults refuse without changing what the user entered
cases.mapping: Original edited controls plus legacy textarea preserve live values/focus/FormData and exact original nodes on VALUE; old repair/subsequent binding retired. A separate new control proves matching edited readonly INPUT_TARGET versus literal initial preservation.

cases.original: an untouched page whose server agrees with the client is adopted without one DOM write
cases.current: an untouched page whose server agrees with the client is adopted without one DOM write
cases.mapping: Untouched controls/title keep FormData and zero DOM writes through a task, with positive observer control.

cases.original: an older server's marker text and unselected select are repaired at adoption
cases.current: an older server's marker text and unselected select refuse without repair
cases.mapping: Legacy RCDATA markers and select default repair replaced by VALUE with exact originals and inert subsequent signals; matching title/control positives retained elsewhere.

cases.original: after the user types, a textarea's reactive text controls its live and default values, client-rendered and adopted alike
cases.current: after the user types, a textarea's reactive text controls its live and default values, client-rendered and adopted alike
cases.mapping: Reactive textarea later controls both live/default values, matching current ordinary CSR; original user edit sequence preserved.

cases.original: a component that returns a DOM node is adopted as itself or reported, and never aborts the module
cases.current: components returning real DOM nodes are refused without replacing originals or aborting the module
cases.mapping: Real DOM/template component returns now STRUCTURE rather than implicit adoption; original module continuation, inert failed effects and server content preserved. Manual user addEventListener is not claimed to be auto-removed.

cases.original: an option bound to undefined submits its text, client-rendered and adopted
cases.current: an option bound to undefined submits its text, client-rendered and adopted
cases.mapping: Nullish option values retain exact native FormData positive.

cases.original: an inline SVG icon is adopted without one DOM write; its title stays SVG and a bound path updates in place
cases.current: an inline SVG icon is adopted without one DOM write; its title stays SVG and a bound path updates in place
cases.mapping: SVG identity, namespaces/accessibility and exact later path mutation retained; zero initial writes.

cases.original: SVG and MathML are adopted in place, and what adoption must create inside them gets their namespace
cases.current: SVG and MathML refuse missing or differing originals, then matching native trees update in place
cases.mapping: Original missing/mismatched MathML/SVG becomes MARKER refusal; matching companion preserves all namespace/identity/live math assertions. Later namespace creation remains in Show/List/switch/portal case.

cases.original: a bound iframe src the server already rendered is not set again, so the frame is not reloaded
cases.current: a bound iframe src the server already rendered is not set again, so the frame is not reloaded
cases.mapping: Existing iframe src does not reload; later genuine navigation remains.

cases.original: a list whose client array differs in count from the server rows leaves the island error with its code and removes no node
cases.current: a list whose client array differs in count from the server rows leaves the island error with its code and removes no node
cases.mapping: Fewer/more List retain exact markup, coded refusal, one status write/owner and no node removal; equal neighbor now zero writes and internally live. New diagnostic reports exact DOM extent, not inferred row count.

cases.original: the namespace vectors: the parser, h() and adoption agree on every element and on the markup
cases.current: the namespace vectors: the parser, h() and adoption agree on every element and on the markup
cases.mapping: All namespace vectors and script refusals unchanged; parser/CSR/adopter equality retained; zero writes includes macrotask and positive observer.

cases.current: content built inside an svg is SVG and rendered once: a createShow branch, list rows, switch cases, a portal; a foreignObject holds HTML
cases.mapping: Initial Show/List server markup now matches client; all later branches/rows/switch/portal/foreignObject namespace/render-count assertions retained.

cases.original: a reactive dangerouslySetInnerHTML is adopted as content, follows its signal through null and back, and matches client rendering
cases.current: a reactive dangerouslySetInnerHTML is adopted as content, follows its signal through null and back, and matches client rendering
cases.mapping: Empty server/raw initial mismatch preserved as VALUE; matching positive keeps original A→B→null→A→C CSR equality and failed owner inert.

cases.mapping: Falsy raw undefined/null/false fallback children and handlers retained.

cases.current: markup the server wrote in a form the browser serialises differently is adopted without one DOM write, and typed text survives
